title: Unique Smoky Kenyan Chicken Skewers
description: A citrusy and tender Kenyan dish featuring desiccated coconut, grilled to perfection on a yakimono grill, and suitable for an ayurvedic tamasic diet. This recipe combines the flavors of Africa and Asia in a unique and delicious way.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Sprinkle the desiccated coconut over the chicken.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional desiccated coconut if desired.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve with your favorite sides, such as grilled vegetables or roasted sweet potatoes.
